texts: talking or singing is hard work
listening along: rest your voice and watch the ring
If hoarseness or discomfort lasts more than a couple
of weeks, see a doctor (a GP or an ear, nose and
throat specialist). If it’s very painful, or breathing or
swallowing is hard, get help straight away.
